sequence_structure.prediction_description: At position 10 (second S5), predict T (position 5). With zero distractors, T is only 5 positions from the prediction point, allowing direct-copy attention without compositional induction.

token_construction: Sequences are token ID lists, NOT text. All tokens are word_en BPE tokens with Ġ (U+0120) space prefix baked into the embedding. Feed token_ids directly to the model. Do NOT re-tokenize. BOS is NOT included — prepend it at inference time if needed.
